reason: This plugin’s primary purpose is visualizing Mermaid content in the DeepSeek Harness web interface: it converts settled `mermaid` fenced code blocks into SVG diagrams and adds zoom and fullscreen interactions. Evidence from the README describes its rendering scope, UI controls, and lifecycle cleanup, indicating a user-facing visualization and interface enhancement plugin rather than backend automation, search, or data-processing functionality.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中将已完成的 Mermaid 代码块渲染为图表，并提供缩放与全屏查看交互。
summaries.en: This plugin renders completed Mermaid code blocks as diagrams in the DeepSeek Harness web interface and provides zoom and fullscreen viewing interactions.

capabilities: Renders Mermaid diagrams from markdown code blocks in the DeepSeek Harness web UI
Adds interactive zoom controls and fullscreen viewing for rendered charts
Observes and mutates web-page code block DOM
Restores original blocks and removes injected UI on plugin disposal

reasons.code: Exact-mermaid-fence rendering is explicitly scoped to settled markdown code blocks
Web plugin integration is declared with client bundle targeting web platform
Behavior includes zoom/fullscreen interaction and plugin cleanup of injected DOM elements
